# Current field-planning authority

As of 2026-10-22, use `decision-checks-2026-10-22/checks.json` and its README for
checks within the hundred-day plan. Start with an actual decision and desk
sources; schedule fieldwork only for unresolved evidence that can change it.
No district quota or fixed field schedule is authorized by this plan.

The 2026-10-20 district-first priorities and the citywide delivery field schedule
are superseded, unexecuted planning records. Preserve their numbers for historical
reproduction; do not use them as the current workload, budget or completion goal.
Research observations and original quantitative analysis remain unchanged.
